title: Product / Voice Search Flow
slide_intent: Carry identity through a task so visual feedback helps people follow the transition from asking to receiving an answer.
strategic_value: The recurring dots and wordmark can make a Google voice query feel like one continuous service.
demonstration: A phone demonstration opens voice input, displays the spoken weather query, animates processing dots and reveals a New York weather result.
practical_value: Check whether branded feedback remains understandable across input, processing and result states within one actual flow.

content_islands.name: Phone frame
content_islands.spec: Keep a single portrait phone fixed on the pale background.

content_islands.name: Query and result sequence
content_islands.spec: Move from the search bar to a voice overlay, transcribed query, animated feedback and weather result inside that phone.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying article identifies Search as the first product embodiment of the identity’s text and voice expression.
reference_purposes.Expression: The dots, bars and logotype keep the recognizable color family through the flow.
reference_purposes.Application: The clip places the identity states inside a complete voice-search example.
